fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: Your passport must expire at least 6 months after arrival and 3 months after your planned departure.
entry.es: El pasaporte debe vencer al menos 6 meses después de la llegada y 3 meses después de la salida prevista.
entry.quote: your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive and 3 months after your planned departure date.

entry.en: You must complete an online arrival form on the D’Viajeros portal within 72 hours before entering, and show the QR code on arrival.
entry.es: Debe completar el formulario de llegada en línea en D’Viajeros dentro de las 72 horas previas a la entrada y mostrar el código QR al llegar.
entry.quote: You must complete an online arrival form on the D’Viajeros traveller information portal within 72 hours before entering the country.

entry.en: You must show proof of onward or return travel.
entry.es: Debe presentar prueba de viaje de continuación o de regreso.
entry.quote: You must also show proof of onward or return travel.

entry.en: Drones are not allowed into Cuba and will be confiscated on arrival until you depart.
entry.es: No se permite ingresar drones a Cuba y se confiscan a la llegada hasta su salida.
entry.quote: You are not allowed to bring drones into Cuba. They will be confiscated on arrival and not returned until your departure.

entry.en: A yellow fever vaccination certificate is required if you come from a country listed as a transmission risk.
entry.es: Se requiere certificado de vacunación contra la fiebre amarilla si viene de un país con riesgo de transmisión.
entry.quote: You must have a certificate to prove you’ve had a yellow fever vaccination if you’re coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.

entry.en: Foreign currency worth more than 5,000 US dollars must be declared when taking it into Cuba.
entry.es: Debe declarar la moneda extranjera si su valor supera los 5.000 dólares estadounidenses.
entry.quote: Declare foreign currency you’re taking into Cuba if the value is more than 5,000 US dollars.

safety.en: Protests have been frequent and can escalate, so stay away from large gatherings.
safety.es: Las protestas han sido frecuentes y pueden intensificarse, por lo que debe evitar las grandes concentraciones.
safety.quote: To date most of these have remained peaceful but be aware that protests can escalate. You should stay away from large gatherings

safety.en: Further collapses of the national electric grid are likely, with sustained disruption to transport, medical care, communications and water.
safety.es: Es probable que haya más colapsos de la red eléctrica nacional, con interrupciones prolongadas del transporte, la atención médica, las comunicaciones y el agua.
safety.quote: Given current circumstances, further grid collapses are likely.

safety.en: Pickpockets and bag-snatchers operate in the streets of Old Havana, crowded areas, public transport and nightclubs.
safety.es: Hay carteristas y ladrones de bolsos en las calles de La Habana Vieja, zonas concurridas, transporte público y discotecas.
safety.quote: Be aware of pickpockets and bag-snatching:

safety.en: Fake taxi drivers operate at the airport and around Old Havana, so use a registered yellow taxi.
safety.es: Hay falsos taxistas en el aeropuerto y en La Habana Vieja; use un taxi amarillo registrado.
safety.quote: These fake drivers operate at the airport and around Old Havana. Only travel with your tour operator. If you need to use a taxi from the airport, make sure it’s a registered yellow taxi.

safety.en: Cuba has a zero tolerance policy against the use, possession and trafficking of illegal drugs.
safety.es: Cuba aplica tolerancia cero al consumo, posesión y tráfico de drogas ilegales.
safety.quote: Cuba has a zero tolerance policy against the use, possession and trafficking of illegal drugs.

safety.en: Photographing military zones or restricted areas can be regarded as espionage and could result in a prison sentence.
safety.es: Fotografiar zonas militares o restringidas puede considerarse espionaje y acarrear pena de prisión.
safety.quote: Possession of photographs or information relating to military areas or installations can be regarded as espionage and could result in a prison sentence.

health.en: The ambulance number is 104, but the service is limited and generally unreliable outside urban areas.
health.es: El número de ambulancias es el 104, pero el servicio es limitado y poco fiable fuera de las zonas urbanas.
health.quote: The ambulance service is limited and generally unreliable, particularly in emergencies outside urban areas.

health.en: Mosquito-borne diseases such as dengue, Oropouche and chikungunya continue to circulate in Cuba.
health.es: Enfermedades transmitidas por mosquitos como dengue, Oropouche y chikungunya siguen circulando en Cuba.

health.en: There are severe shortages of basic medicines in Cuba.
health.es: En Cuba hay una grave escasez de medicamentos básicos.
health.quote: There are severe shortages of basic medicines, but clinics treating foreigners are more likely to stock basic medical supplies.

health.en: Foreigners or their insurers must pay in foreign currency before treatment, and Visa/Mastercard payments cannot be made.
health.es: Los extranjeros o sus aseguradoras deben pagar en divisas antes del tratamiento y no se pueden usar Visa/Mastercard.
health.quote: you or your insurance company will need to pay with foreign currency (most likely USD) before any treatment, bearing in mind that Visa/Mastercard payments cannot be made.

health.en: Wikivoyage says the water is the main health concern and recommends bottled water.
health.es: Wikivoyage indica que el agua es la principal preocupación sanitaria y recomienda agua embotellada.
health.quote: Cuba is considered very healthy except for the water; even many Cubans boil their water.

health.en: Wikivoyage says pharmacies lack many medications such as aspirin and ibuprofen, so stock up on over-the-counter medicines beforehand.
health.es: Wikivoyage indica que las farmacias carecen de muchos medicamentos como aspirina e ibuprofeno, por lo que conviene llevar los de venta libre.
health.quote: It is highly recommended to stock up on over-the-counter medications before heading to Cuba, as pharmacies lack many medications that westerners might expect to find

help.en: Emergency numbers are ambulance 104, fire 105 and police 106.
help.es: Los números de emergencia son ambulancia 104, bomberos 105 y policía 106.

getting_in.en: José Martí International Airport outside Havana is the main gateway to Cuba.
getting_in.es: El Aeropuerto Internacional José Martí, cerca de La Habana, es la principal puerta de entrada a Cuba.
getting_in.quote: José Martí International Airport outside Havana is the main gateway

getting_in.en: Flights were also available to Santiago de Cuba from Jamaica and Haiti.
getting_in.es: También había vuelos a Santiago de Cuba desde Jamaica y Haití.
getting_in.quote: there were also flights available to Santiago de Cuba from some of Cuba's nearest Caribbean neighbours, Jamaica and Haiti.

getting_in.en: Checked luggage is at great risk of being opened and valuables removed at Cuban airports.
getting_in.es: El equipaje facturado corre un gran riesgo de ser abierto y que le quiten objetos de valor en los aeropuertos cubanos.
getting_in.quote: It is increasingly common for your luggage to be opened and anything of value removed.

getting_around.en: The bus is the most popular way of getting around the island.
getting_around.es: El autobús es la forma más popular de moverse por la isla.
getting_around.quote: The bus is the most popular way of getting around the island.

getting_around.en: Viazul is the long-distance bus line generally for tourists and Astro the one generally for locals.
getting_around.es: Viazul es la línea de autobuses de larga distancia generalmente para turistas y Astro la que suele usarse por locales.
getting_around.quote: There are two long-distance bus lines, Viazul, which is generally for tourists and Astro, which is generally for locals.

getting_around.en: Viazul reservations are typically only necessary for popular destinations in high season.
getting_around.es: Las reservas de Viazul normalmente solo son necesarias para destinos populares en temporada alta.
getting_around.quote: Reservations can be made in advance on their website, but this is typically only necessary when leaving from or going to popular destinations in high season.

getting_around.en: Shared taxis (collectivos) carry 3 to 5 passengers and cost about the same as an equivalent Viazul ticket; negotiate the price first.
getting_around.es: Los taxis compartidos (colectivos) llevan de 3 a 5 pasajeros y cuestan similar a un boleto de Viazul; negocie el precio antes.
getting_around.quote: Prices for a collectivo are about the same as for an equivalent Viazul bus ticket. Be sure to negotiate a price before hopping in the car.

money.en: The Cuban Central Bank has announced that Visa and Mastercard are no longer accepted, and ATM withdrawals with international cards are not possible.
money.es: El Banco Central de Cuba anunció que Visa y Mastercard ya no se aceptan y no se puede retirar efectivo con tarjetas internacionales.
money.quote: You will not be able to withdraw cash through ATMs with an international card.

money.en: Bring enough cash for your whole stay; US dollars and euros are widely accepted and can be exchanged.
money.es: Lleve efectivo suficiente para toda la estancia; los dólares estadounidenses y los euros se aceptan ampliamente y se pueden cambiar.
money.quote: US dollars and euros are widely accepted and can be exchanged in Cuba.

money.en: It is illegal to exchange money anywhere other than Cadeca exchange houses.
money.es: Es ilegal cambiar dinero en lugares distintos de las casas de cambio Cadeca.
money.quote: It is illegal to exchange money anywhere other than Cadeca exchange houses

money.en: Wikivoyage says a standard 3% fee is charged on all currency exchange.
money.es: Wikivoyage indica que se cobra una comisión estándar del 3% en todo cambio de divisas.
money.quote: A standard 3% fee is charged on all currency exchange.

money.en: Wikivoyage says private businesses such as casas particulares and paladares will never accept cards.
money.es: Wikivoyage indica que los negocios privados como casas particulares y paladares nunca aceptan tarjeta.
money.quote: private businesses such as casas particulares and paladares will never accept card, necessitating the use of cash.

etiquette.en: Wikivoyage advises avoiding political discussions, which can make Cubans uncomfortable and suspicious.
etiquette.es: Wikivoyage aconseja evitar discusiones políticas, que pueden incomodar y despertar sospechas.
etiquette.quote: Avoid having political discussions or inquiring more about local politics

etiquette.en: Wikivoyage advises against photographing police, soldiers and other authority figures without consent.
etiquette.es: Wikivoyage desaconseja fotografiar a policías, soldados y otras autoridades sin su consentimiento.
etiquette.quote: Do not take photographs of policemen, soldiers, and other authority figures without their consent.

etiquette.en: Wikivoyage says many people working in tourism see tourists as walking wallets, so be ready to say no to offers.
etiquette.es: Wikivoyage dice que muchos trabajadores del turismo ven a los turistas como carteras ambulantes, así que esté listo para decir que no.
etiquette.quote: Tourists are considered being "walking wallets" by many locals working in tourism

etiquette.en: Wikivoyage says staying in casas particulares and eating in paladares directly benefits local Cubans.
etiquette.es: Wikivoyage dice que alojarse en casas particulares y comer en paladares beneficia directamente a los cubanos.
etiquette.quote: One way to help local Cubans is by staying in casas particulares and eating in paladares or private restaurants and buying from street vendors.

connectivity.en: Wikivoyage says Cuba is by design one of the most expensive and difficult places in which to communicate.
connectivity.es: Wikivoyage dice que Cuba es, por diseño, uno de los lugares más caros y difíciles para comunicarse.
connectivity.quote: Cuba is, by design, one of the most expensive and difficult places in which to communicate.

connectivity.en: Wikivoyage says some wifi hotspots require a prepaid scratch card, bought from ETESCA centres or hotels.
connectivity.es: Wikivoyage indica que algunas redes wifi requieren una tarjeta prepago de rasca, que se compra en centros ETESCA u hoteles.
connectivity.quote: Before you can connect to some WiFis, you will need to purchase a pre-paid scratch card.

connectivity.en: Internet access can sometimes be blocked during times of political tension.
connectivity.es: El acceso a internet a veces puede bloquearse en momentos de tensión política.
connectivity.quote: Internet access can sometime be blocked during times of political tension.

connectivity.en: Wikivoyage says most providers do not offer roaming in Cuba, so check with your phone company.
connectivity.es: Wikivoyage indica que la mayoría de los operadores no ofrecen roaming en Cuba, así que consulte con su compañía.
connectivity.quote: If you plan on using international roaming, be sure to check with your phone company as most providers do not offer roaming in Cuba.
